content.title: How to watch tonight’s Yankees vs. Giants game for free: Start time, channel, livestream
content.text: New York Post may receive revenue from affiliate and advertising partnerships for sharing this content and/or when you make a purchase. An image collage containing 1 images, Image 1 shows New York Yankees designated hitter Giancarlo Stanton tossing his bat after hitting a home runThe New York Yankees have the opportunity to sweep their very first series of the 2026 MLB season tonight.AdvertisementAfter an opening night shutout against the San Francisco Giants, the Bronx Bombers were back in action last night, where they shut the Giants out again, 3-0.Yankees captain Aaron Judge snapped his 0-for-7 start to the season in the victory with a two-run homer in the sixth inning. During that same at-bat, he challenged a strike call, which was overturned with the new automated system.Yankees vs. Giants: what to knowWhen: March 28, 7:15 p.m. ETWhere: Oracle Park (San Francisco, California)Channel: FOXStreaming: Fubo (try it free)The Giants made franchise history in the losses; it’s the first time, in the 143-year existence of the Giants, that the team was held scoreless throughout the first two games of the season. It’s expected new manager Tony Vitello will make lineup changes going into tonight’s series finale.AdvertisementThe Yankees vs. Giants game is scheduled to begin at 7:15 p.m. ET.What channel is tonight’s Yankees game on?Tonight’s Yankees game is airing nationally on FOX.How to watch Yankees vs. Giants for freeIf you don’t have cable, the best way to tune into as much of the Yankees’ season as possible is by using a live TV streaming service.Fubo is one of our favorites — and one we especially recommend to sports fans. The service offers a number of live TV plans that have all of the channels you’ll need to stream the Yankees all season long, including FOX, where tonight’s game is airing.AdvertisementTRY FUBO FOR FREEBoth the Pro plan ($48.99 for your first month) and the Sports + News package ($45.99 for your first month) come with a free trial.Yankees vs. Giants starting pitchersWill Warren will be on the mound for the Yankees; Tyler Mahle gets the start for the Giants.When is the Yankees’ home opener?The Yankees home opener is scheduled for Friday, April 3. The team will head to Seattle for a three game series starting Monday, March 30 before heading home.
